```{=html}
<style>

/* =========================================================
   RESET
   ========================================================= */

body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: #F7F6F2;
}

#quarto-content,
.page-layout-full {
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

.quarto-title-block {
  display: none;
}

main.content {
  padding: 0 !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   DESIGN TOKENS
   ========================================================= */

:root {
  --navy:   #0D1B2A;
  --teal:   #00A878;
  --gold:   #E8C547;
  --ink:    #1A1A2E;
  --mist:   #F7F6F2;
  --slate:  #4A5568;
  --muted:  #718096;
  --border: #E2E0DA;
  --card:   #FFFFFF;

  --display: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
  --serif:   'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif;
  --mono:    'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
}


/* =========================================================
   GLOBAL
   ========================================================= */

a {
  text-decoration: none;
}

.section {
  max-width: 920px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 78px 48px;
}

.section-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--teal);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.section-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(25px, 3.5vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}

.section-divider {
  width: 40px;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--teal);
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 38px;
}


/* =========================================================
   HERO
   ========================================================= */

.hero {
  background: var(--navy);
  padding: 100px 48px 88px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -100px;
  right: -80px;
  width: 520px;
  height: 520px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle,
      rgba(0,168,120,0.14) 0%,
      rgba(0,168,120,0.04) 40%,
      transparent 72%
    );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -180px;
  left: 45%;
  width: 420px;
  height: 420px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-inner {
  max-width: 920px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.hero-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--teal);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.hero-name {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(42px, 7vw, 76px);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #F7F6F2;
  line-height: 1.02;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}

.hero-name span {
  color: var(--teal);
}

.hero-role {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(18px, 2.5vw, 25px);
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #CBD5E0;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.hero-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 19px);
  font-weight: 300;
  color: #A0AEC0;
  margin: 0 0 34px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 680px;
}

.hero-title strong {
  color: #CBD5E0;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.hero-badges {
  display: flex;
  gap: 9px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
}

.badge {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 6px 11px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.badge-outline {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
  color: #A0AEC0;
  background: transparent;
}

.badge-teal {
  background: rgba(0,168,120,0.13);
  color: var(--teal);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,168,120,0.28);
}

.hero-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 22px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.hero-link {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--teal);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.hero-link::after {
  content: ' ↗';
}

.hero-link.secondary {
  color: #718096;
}


/* =========================================================
   ABOUT
   ========================================================= */

.about-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.35fr;
  gap: 58px;
  align-items: start;
}

.profile-photo-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.profile-photo {
  width: 125px;
  height: 125px;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center top;
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 3px solid var(--teal);
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--teal);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.profile-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.profile-name {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.profile-role {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--teal);
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.profile-uni {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--slate);
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.about-text {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.82;
  color: var(--slate);
}

.about-text p {
  margin: 0 0 17px;
}

.about-text p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.focus-list {
  margin-top: 28px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
}

.focus-item {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top: 12px;
}

.focus-item-title {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--teal);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.focus-item-text {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink);
}


/* =========================================================
   EXPERIENCE
   ========================================================= */

.experience-bg {
  background: #FFFFFF;
}

.experience-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr;
  gap: 42px;
  padding: 30px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.experience-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.experience-date {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  line-height: 1.7;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.experience-role {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.experience-company {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--teal);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.experience-description {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--slate);
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin-bottom: 13px;
}

.experience-points {
  margin: 0;
  padding-left: 18px;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--slate);
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.experience-points li {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}


/* =========================================================
   WORKFLOW
   ========================================================= */

.workflow-bg {
  background: var(--mist);
}

.workflow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  gap: 0;
  position: relative;
}

.workflow::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 24px;
  left: 8%;
  right: 8%;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--border);
  z-index: 0;
}

.workflow-step {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0 10px;
}

.workflow-number {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  margin: 0 auto 17px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--mist);
  border: 1px solid var(--teal);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--teal);
}

.workflow-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 7px;
}

.workflow-text {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}


/* =========================================================
   PROJECTS
   ========================================================= */

.projects-bg {
  background: var(--navy);
}

.projects-bg .section-title {
  color: #F7F6F2;
}

.projects-bg .section-label {
  color: var(--teal);
}

.project-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.project-card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.045);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 28px 26px 25px;
  transition:
    border-color 0.2s,
    transform 0.2s,
    background 0.2s;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.project-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--teal);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.project-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0,168,120,0.45);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.065);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}

.project-card:hover::before {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

.project-card.upcoming {
  border-style: dashed;
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.project-card.upcoming:hover {
  transform: none;
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.045);
}

.project-card.upcoming::before {
  display: none;
}

.project-number {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--teal);
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.project-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #F7F6F2;
  margin: 0 0 11px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.project-desc {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #A0AEC0;
  line-height: 1.65;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
}

.project-result {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #CBD5E0;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  padding-left: 12px;
  border-left: 2px solid rgba(0,168,120,0.45);
}

.project-result strong {
  color: var(--teal);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.project-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.tag {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  background: rgba(0,168,120,0.12);
  color: var(--teal);
  border-radius: 2px;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.tag-gold {
  background: rgba(232,197,71,0.12);
  color: var(--gold);
}

.project-links {
  display: flex;
  gap: 18px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.project-link {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--teal);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.project-link::after {
  content: ' ↗';
}

.upcoming-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--gold);
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}


/* =========================================================
   TECHNICAL STACK
   ========================================================= */

.skills-bg {
  background: #FFFFFF;
}

.stack-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
}

.stack-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 5px;
  padding: 25px;
  background: #FFFFFF;
}

.stack-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(0,168,120,0.45);
}

.stack-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 13px;
}

.stack-description {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--slate);
  line-height: 1.65;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.stack-tools {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.stack-tool {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--slate);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 4px 7px;
  border-radius: 2px;
}


/* =========================================================
   EDUCATION
   ========================================================= */

.education-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr;
  gap: 42px;
  padding: 26px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.education-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.education-type {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--teal);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.education-degree {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.education-school {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--slate);
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.education-detail {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}


/* =========================================================
   CTA
   ========================================================= */

.cta {
  background: var(--navy);
  padding: 82px 48px 70px;
  text-align: center;
}

.cta-inner {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.cta-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--teal);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 13px;
}

.cta-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
  color: #F7F6F2;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  margin: 0 0 15px;
}

.cta-text {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #A0AEC0;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin: 0 auto 30px;
  max-width: 570px;
}

.cta-links {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.cta-link {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.07em;
  color: var(--teal);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,168,120,0.35);
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}

.cta-link:hover {
  background: rgba(0,168,120,0.10);
}


/* =========================================================
   FOOTER
   ========================================================= */

.footer {
  background: var(--navy);
  padding: 25px 48px 35px;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
}

.footer-text {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: #4A5568;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

.footer-text a {
  color: var(--teal);
}


/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 760px) {

  .hero {
    padding: 70px 24px 65px;
  }

  .section {
    padding: 60px 24px;
  }

  .about-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 38px;
  }

  .project-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .stack-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .workflow {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 26px;
  }

  .workflow::before {
    display: none;
  }

  .workflow-step {
    text-align: left;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr;
    column-gap: 15px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .workflow-number {
    grid-row: span 2;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .experience-item,
  .education-item {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .focus-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .profile-photo {
    width: 100px;
    height: 100px;
  }

  .cta {
    padding: 65px 24px 55px;
  }

  .footer {
    padding: 24px;
  }
}

</style>


<!-- =======================================================
     HERO
======================================================= -->

<!-- =======================================================
     EXPERIENCE
======================================================= -->

<div class="experience-bg">

  <div class="section">

    <div class="section-label">
      Experience
    </div>

    <h2 class="section-title">
      Professional experience
    </h2>

    <div class="section-divider"></div>
